Preserved: The context is immutable for one exported page, contains only destination facts supplied for that page, and is consumed without layout, filesystem access, routing policy, or mutation during traversal.
Violated: The exporter invents or mutates destination facts, consults external state, performs layout, or admits entries belonging to a different page.
Unknown: The supplied context provenance or page identity cannot be established, so no claim based on it is made.

input: export_svg or export_svg_with_fonts called without explicit destination context
observable: compatibility with an empty internal-destination context
Preserved: Each legacy wrapper behaves as its corresponding explicit-context variant with an empty destination context; external URLs, visual children, transforms, and clickable geometry retain their prior semantics.
Violated: A wrapper fabricates destinations, changes URL behavior or visible/clickable morphology, or diverges from the empty-context variant for reasons attributable to destination handling.
Unknown: An internal destination remains unresolved under the empty context and is classified Unknown without a fragment href; this is not preservation of that internal edge.

input: pipeline has a selected page plus extracted_label_pages and extracted_label_positions
Preserved: The pipeline includes a label exactly when its recorded page is the selected page and a finite representable homologous position exists; no entry from another page is included.
Violated: The context includes cross-page labels, includes a label without its measured position, pairs a label with another label's position, or omits a complete same-page destination.
Unknown: An absent, ambiguous, nonfinite, or unrepresentable page/position association is excluded and remains Unknown rather than synthesized.

input: page-local context derivation after PagedDocument layout
Preserved: The pipeline derives the context from the completed PagedDocument, selects the exported page, and passes immutable data to the explicit exporter variant without moving maps into Page, creating FrameItems, repeating layout, or deciding ID spelling.
Violated: Destination handling changes the public Page/FrameItem model, repeats evaluation/layout, or delegates page filtering back to an exporter that lacks document page authority.
Unknown: If the selected page or homologous destination position is unavailable, the affected destination is omitted as Unknown.

input: two or more distinct same-page labels, including labels with equal positions
Preserved: Every distinct label that is admitted to the context receives one deterministic local identity; equal labels reuse that identity and distinct labels never collide even when their positions are equal.
Violated: Identity depends on traversal accident, rendered text, address, unstable bytes, or position alone; repeated input changes identities; or distinct labels alias one node.
Unknown: If label identity is opaque or ambiguous, the affected destination is not admitted and no href or node is emitted for it.

input: a representable same-page label and measured position in context
Preserved: Exactly one local node carrying the label's assigned identity is emitted at the measured page-local position; renaming the identity or changing equivalent SVG element spelling is mechanical.
Violated: The node is absent, duplicated with conflicting identity, placed at a fabricated/different position, or transformed in a basis different from the measured page-local basis.
Unknown: An absent, nonfinite, or unrepresentable position yields no invented node and an explicit Unknown disposition for dependent edges.

input: LinkTarget::Destination(label) whose label has a valid same-page context entry
Preserved: The link wrapper references the single local identity assigned to that label and exactly one corresponding destination node resolves in the same SVG semantic graph.
Violated: The href is dangling, resolves to zero or multiple nodes, resolves to another label or position, bypasses the node, or claims preservation without a closed edge.
Unknown: If unique local resolution cannot be established, children remain and the internal link is Unknown with no fragment href.

input: LinkTarget::Destination(label) absent from the page-local context
Preserved: No fragment href and no fabricated destination node or position are emitted; the wrapper's visual/clickable content is retained and the edge is classified Unknown.
Violated: A fragment href is emitted, the label is silently redirected, a position is invented, children are dropped, or the edge is called Preserved.
Unknown: The required outcome is Unknown; downstream visual resemblance or an empty anchor element cannot promote it.

input: LinkTarget::Destination(label) recorded on another page and no explicit caller route exists
Preserved: The label is excluded from the page-local context; no local fragment, filename, bundle path, URI, or false destination node is invented, while link children remain and the edge is Unknown.
Violated: The exporter turns the label into a local fragment, guesses a page filename or route, emits a dangling href, or claims the cross-page edge is preserved.
Unknown: Cross-page routing remains Unknown until a caller with an explicit route contract supplies it; same-position coincidence across pages is not evidence.

input: LinkTarget::Url carrying a representable URL string
Preserved: The semantic URL is preserved independently of internal-destination context, including under an empty context; XML escaping and href versus xlink:href spelling are mechanical when the resolved URL is unchanged.
Violated: Destination-context handling removes, rewrites, fragments, aliases, or conditionally suppresses the external URL, or points it to a local destination node.
Unknown: If the URL carrier itself is outside the representable SVG attribute fragment, the exporter must not substitute an internal destination; no broader URL-equivalence claim is made.

input: URL or internal link nested under groups/transforms and containing its measured clickable region
observable: visual children, transform basis, nesting, and clickable area
Preserved: Destination handling preserves the wrapper's existing children/transparent hit geometry, nesting order, and one shared transform basis; closing an internal edge changes only destination graph semantics.
Violated: Children or hit area are removed or enlarged/shrunk, transforms are applied zero or multiple times or in different bases, or nesting is flattened so the clickable/visible morphology changes.
Unknown: If child rendering or clickable geometry is outside the supported observable fragment, its morphology is Unknown and cannot prove edge preservation.

input: alpha-renaming of destination IDs, permutation of context entries, or permutation of equivalent destination-node emission order
Preserved: Repeated exports and reorderings yield the same label-to-position-to-edge graph, with collision-free identities and equivalent clickable/visual output; concrete ID tokens and XML order may differ only by declared alpha-renaming.
Violated: Order changes which label an edge reaches, creates/removes a node, changes position or morphology, introduces a collision, or makes output classification nondeterministic.
Unknown: Opaque graph resolution remains Unknown; byte identity and literal ID spelling alone never decide preservation.

input: multiple internal link wrappers target the same valid same-page label
observable: many edges to one destination node
Preserved: All wrappers resolve to the one intended local destination node without duplicating conflicting nodes; each wrapper retains its own content, transform, and clickable region.
Violated: Edges targeting the same label receive inconsistent identities, nodes conflict or multiply semantically, one edge shadows another, or wrapper morphology is shared accidentally.
Unknown: Any wrapper whose own morphology is opaque remains Unknown without invalidating uniquely resolved sibling edges.

observable: no unauthorized carrier or public language expansion
Preserved: The solution uses the existing LinkTarget::Destination edge plus immutable L3 context and normal pipeline data; it adds no public label/location/page-position constructor contract, no destination FrameItem, and no bundle policy.
Violated: The implementation expands public link syntax, creates a public/resolved destination carrier, adds destination FrameItems, or embeds bundle/cross-page policy under P1247.
Unknown: Public constructor coverage and cross-page routing remain explicitly outside this contract and cannot be inferred from same-page success.

input: partially valid context containing valid, missing, opaque, or rejected destinations
observable: locality of Unknown and graph closure
Preserved: Valid same-page entries still form closed edges and nodes; each invalid entry is omitted locally with no dangling reference, no collision, and no false promotion of unrelated links.
Violated: One bad entry corrupts identity allocation, suppresses or retargets valid links, creates any dangling href, or is silently treated as a valid destination.
Unknown: Only the affected unresolved edge is Unknown; Unknown never defaults to Preserved and never authorizes a synthetic node.
